newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Armenian Nov inflation 2.4 pct vs 0.2-pct Oct fall.
newsitem.headline: Armenian Nov inflation 2.4 pct vs 0.2-pct Oct fall.

text.p: Armenian inflation was 2.4 percent in November this year, sharply lower than 22.9 percent in 1995, but the price rise accelerated in comparison to previous months, the Central Bank of Armenia said on Wednesday.
Prices rose just 3.6 percent in the first 11 months of this year, falling slightly in recent months. In January-November last year, inflation was about 210 percent.
